title: Sean McVay: We'll err on the side of caution with Puka Nacua

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay: We'll err on the side of caution with Puka Nacua
sources.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua missed Week 2 with a groin injury and his outlook for this week's game against the Broncos remains unclear.
